nodes.title: Stream K slice K0 (Kaksha, behind ui.kaksha, default off; claude/r4-app-design): scoped Kaksha tokens (.v3.kx; night for the Older family, dawn for the Young family, keyed on band family), Space Grotesk font, KakshaRoot/Sky/Comms shell, Start-only Home (safety_hold/offline/signed-out fall through to today's Home unchanged), World orbit + settlement + Hangar as a pure function of GET /api/child/map (src/ui-v3/kaksha/world.ts, data/kaksha/catalog.json), per-child equip on device, dev fixture page; patch requests K-P8 (src/child/routes.tsx) and K-P7 (scripts/lint-ui.mjs allow). docs/design/round4/build/kaksha/RESULTS.md

Kaksha economy logic test (tests/r4-kaksha-economy.test.mjs, 2026-10-10): 6/6 pass; stations/structures/opened items exist iff a matching skill is secure over 200 random maps; monotonic over 300 random promotions; no clock or Math.random in world.ts; deterministic and append-only settlement slots given secure_since; no counts exposed; no price/chance/currency fields.

Kaksha rendered lint (tests/prod/r4-kaksha-shots.mjs, Playwright Chromium on the dev fixture page, 8 states x 360/412/1366 x night/dawn = 48 page states, 606 text elements, 2026-10-10): 0 text < 14 px, 0 Devanagari < 16 px, 0 targets < 44 px, 0 contrast fails, 0 overflow, 0 page errors, after fixing one real defect the first run found (Start label 1.33:1 on plasma: a generic reset outranked the CTA colour; fixed with :where() resets). lint-ui stays at its 353 baseline with K-P7 (491 without). Kaksha lazy chunks about 12.4 KB JS + 4.9 KB CSS gzip.

Tried: npm test in a fresh stream container after npm ci (2026-10-10). Broke: playwright 1.63 looks for /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1243 but the image ships 1194, so every browser-backed test fails in its before() hook (1,843 fails in 15 s, none from the change). Local workaround without playwright install: symlink the 1194 headless_shell files into chromium_headless_shell-1243/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/ (binary named chrome-headless-shell). A stream's npm test result is only meaningful after that.

Stream K slice K1 (claude/r4-app-design, behind ui.kaksha + the server owner cohort): the Kaksha Desk skin (CSS only over the Desk's own tokens and data-zone attributes; the lamp stays on the Answer dock, plasma) and the Debrief in place of the Summary (What you did = the Summary's verified cards; Now secure = ledger diff of /api/child/map read at lesson start vs end, unknown claims nothing; Opened = World's own function; her closing line only when a statement). Patch request K-P2 to stream 2 (Desk.tsx skin/data-zone/renderSummary, LessonScreen lazy KakshaLesson). docs/design/round4/build/kaksha/RESULTS.md

K1 rendered lint + safety checks (tests/prod/r4-kaksha-desk-shots.mjs, Playwright Chromium, the real Desk with fixture models + the Debrief, 9 states x class 4/6/7 x 360/412/1366 = 81 pages, 1,434 text elements, 2026-10-10): 0 text < 14 px, 0 Devanagari < 16 px, 0 targets < 44 px, 0 contrast fails, 0 overflow; Pause reachable in one tap and 1098/14416 on screen with no scroll on every lesson state; lamp on the dock only; Now secure exactly the crossing skill. lint-ui 353 (baseline).

K1 turn latency on live models (r4-timeline driver, local production build, real Azure models, stream Neon TEST, fixed 750 ms fake ASR, synthetic clip; turn prefetch OFF (preload default; production runs it ON); 4 interleaved arms Kaksha/classic x puppet/still, n=12 turns each, 2026-10-10): end of speech -> POST p50 1,988 / 2,000 (puppet Kaksha/classic), 2,185 / 1,374 (still); POST p50 2,535 / 2,311, 1,991 / 2,451. Bimodal by the conversation's turn-taking (POST 10-35 ms after the final transcript, or held 1-5 s; same turn index lands alike across arms): this n cannot resolve a skin effect. Not a child, not a phone.

K1 client turn latency, deterministic (real LessonRuntime on the Desk dev page's scripted Director; 360x800 DPR 2, CPU x4, SwiftShader = G35-class proxy, not a phone; n=30 per arm, paired by turn position, 2026-10-10): Kaksha minus classic, send -> turn call: still face +1.4 ms (95% CI +/-12.6; p50 128 vs 122 ms), puppet +13 ms (+/-47; p50 530 vs 430, p90 1,104 vs 1,097); answer -> painted: still +17.7 +/-26.5 ms, puppet -4.6 +/-24.0 ms. Every interval includes 0: no measurable added latency.
